findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1598-1613 falls back to child.kill() after fingerprint revalidation rejects negative-PGID signaling; equivalent fallbacks exist at lines 1648-1653 and 1667-1672. If the original leader exited and its PID was reused before close, this can signal an unrelated process, while replacementSafe remains true and processCleanup.reaped mirrors it when the old group is not alive. Ambiguous identity must send no TERM/KILL and must report unresolved residual state with replacementSafe false.

packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:234-239 swallows every unlink failure during stale or corrupt slot reclamation and immediately excludes the still-present slot from occupiedCount. If unlink returns EACCES or EIO after the cap is lowered, a new low-index provider can be admitted past the cap. Re-read after unlink and count or refuse the slot unless absence is proven.

packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:993-1004 accepts managed read evidence when the manifest and readLog are merely non-empty; it never checks that their file sets or summary agree. packages/main/src/handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:198-213 then validates candidate coverage from the manifest alone. A direct Bun probe with a decisions-document manifest, an unrelated source-file log, and readCount 999 returned true, so contradictory read provenance can become formal REVIEW evidence. Reuse the existing read-evidence diagnostics and reject mismatched manifest, log, or summary before sealing and import.

packages/main/src/core/managed-review-evidence.ts:99-101 classifies an importer-subject commit as safe when every changed path is merely under the Story directory and at least one basename is review-passes.json or findings.json. The importer calls autoCommitStoryMetadata, which stages the entire Story directory, so pre-existing checklist, plan, or review metadata changes can ride in the commit. Because live binding accepts this loose classification without revalidating the expected storyFilesHash, altered review requirements can leave the old managed verdict current. Restrict accepted commits to the exact importer-owned artifact set or fail on unrelated Story dirt.

packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:698-717 appends a process event after durable provider submission but before returning or throwing the detached result. If that event write fails, the caller receives only the bookkeeping error and never receives the already-active managedRunId; retrying without the hidden identity can launch a duplicate. Preserve and return the durable identity on post-submit bookkeeping failure, or health-report the event failure without hiding detach success.

packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:1062-1067 removes the detached snapshot as soon as the managed leaf is replacement-safe, before the verdict pair is persisted at lines 1113-1120. A crash or thrown beforeVerdictRecord in that gap leaves no verdict, and an exact retry is rejected at line 1006 because binding.cwd no longer exists. Retain the snapshot until verdict and event persistence are durable, or support safe receipt-only replay.

packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:591-600 does not recognize a provider command resolved through a local mapping or function before spawn. The classifier returns false for a COMMANDS mapping followed by const command = COMMANDS[host] and spawn(command, []), allowing a new unclassified provider launch to bypass the inventory contract. Use AST or dataflow-aware detection, or conservatively classify unresolved child-process launches in provider-bearing files.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1385-1391 silently swallows failure to persist the scratch-cleanup diagnostic after cleanup already could not be proven. This removes the marker that doctor and operators need to distinguish retained managed-review scratch. Keep terminal authority unchanged, but report the persistence failure through the health channel.

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:3208-3215 accepts a one-character findings diagnostic note through the compatibility managed_review_proposal_set ingress. docs/host-run-usage.md:252-260 promises that canonical and compatibility ingress both enforce a trimmed minimum of 10 characters, which the canonical parser does at packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1046-1054. Apply the same minimum to compatibility ingress or correct the documented contract.

readManifest.scanEscalationReason: Candidate artifact must be regenerated at the current reviewed HEAD after the stale Round 74 receipt binding; this is a deterministic local routing refresh without provider document disclosure.
